headers = cli.Text("header", cli.setVerboseName("替换头"), cli.setDefault(<<<HEAD
X-Forwarded-For
X-Forwarded
Forwarded-For
Forwarded
X-Forwarded-Proto
X-Forwarded-Host
X-Remote-IP
X-Remote-addr
True-Client-IP
Client-IP
X-Real-IP
Ali-CDN-Real-IP
Cdn-Src-Ip
CDN-Real-Ip
CF-Connecting-IP
X-Cluster-Client-IP
WL-Proxy-Client-IP
Proxy-Client-IP
Fastly-Client-Ip
True-Client-Ip
X-Originating-IP
X-Host
X-Custom-IP-Authorization
X-Original-Host
X-Original-IP
Via
X-Via
X-Client-IP

HEAD), cli.setRequired(true))
target = cli.String("target", cli.setVerboseName("伪造IP"), cli.setDefault("127.0.0.1"), cli.setRequired(true))
shouldRandom = cli.Bool("random", cli.setRequired(true), cli.setDefault(false), cli.setVerboseName("随机生成IP"))
cli.check()

hijackHTTPRequest = func(isHttps, url, req, forward /*func(modifiedRequest []byte)*/, drop /*func()*/) {
    if shouldRandom {
        target = x`{{ri(1,255)}}.{{ri(0,255)}}.{{ri(0,255)}}.{{ri(0,255)}}`[0]
    }
    for i in headers.Split("\n") {
        i = str.TrimSpace(i)
        if i == "" {
            continue
        }
        req = poc.ReplaceHTTPPacketHeader(req, i, target)
    }
    //db.SaveHTTPFlowFromRawWithOption(url /*type: string*/, req /*type: []byte*/, nil)
    forward(req)
}
help: 通过 XFF 等请求头伪造请求 IP 以绕过一些七层安全设备
